messages:
elaine: Quick sync — Q3/Q4 observability planning. Need to lock scope for dashboards, tracing sampling, and error analysis retention by EOD Friday. Customers are asking for per-route trace drilldowns and 90d logs/metrics by default.

sam: +1. Can we separate UI work (dashboards) from backend retention mechanics? They have different owners and timelines.

kai: We're constrained on SRE infra for retention tiers. 90d full traces is expensive unless we sample/compact. Propose: 7d full traces, 30d index + spans, 90d aggregated metrics.

marta: Customers 1 and 2 explicitly requested per-route traces for latency regressions. They said 30d effective window is minimum.

noah: For OKRs, should we set an objective like: "Make Redwood Console full-trace investigations feasible for 95% of incidents under 30s investigative time"? Then key results: adoption, latency to load, cost per 1k traces.

elaine: That OKR framing is good. Need launch criteria too: MVP must include - per-route filters, trace waterfall view, and retention tier config in console. Anything else blocking?

sam: Blocking: API to query aggregated spans (backend) + a UI skeleton. If we want 30d searchable per-route traces, we need index optimization. Otherwise we default to sampling.

kai: Technical tradeoff: implement prefix KV cache for trace index so queries hit fast, OR build a pre-aggregated route index (cheaper writes). Both add dev time.

marta: Customer-facing criteria: "able to attach trace to session and jump to related logs/metrics". If that's not in MVP, customers will push back.

elaine: Decision call: prioritize index + 30d with sampling fallback, or do 7d full, 30d sampled? Need product preference so eng can estimate.

sam: From infra side, 7d full + 30d sampled is feasible within current budget. 30d full will need a Dedicated capacity SKU conversation.

noah: Could we make a feature-gate: enterprise customers can opt into extended retention and Dedicated-backed indexing? That might align with sales upsell.

kai: Agree. Implement gating: default plan = 7d full / 30d sampled; enterprise toggle -> 90d full with index.

marta: OK, add to launch criteria: enterprise toggle + docs + billing metadata. Also need hit limits + SLOs for query latency.

elaine: For UX, we'll ship a "Retention & Sampling" panel under Project Settings with presets: "Developer (7d)", "Prod (30d sampled)", "Enterprise (90d full)". Sam/Kai, can you estimate dev + infra work?

sam: Roughly 3 sprints for UI + API + basic index support. Need a follow-up scoping ticket.

kai: Infra: 4 sprints to stabilize indexing, add sampling pipeline, and perf test. Might overlap by 1 sprint.

noah: I'll draft OKRs and KRs around adoption, query latency (<300ms p50 for trace queries), and cost/mo per 10k traces.

elaine: Action items:
- noah: draft OKRs doc by Tue (1791310000)
- sam: create scoping ticket for UI + API by Mon
- kai: run cost model + infra plan and post numbers by Wed
- marta: confirm 2 pilot customers and compile acceptance criteria by Thu

ops-bot: Reminder: roadmap planning meeting scheduled <@elaine> <@sam> Tue 10:30am. Agenda pinned.

sam: Thx everyone. If no major objections, I'll start the ticket and include two scope options (default gate vs full 30d). :thumbsup:

marta: :thumbsup:

elaine: No objections. We'll review scope options in Tue meeting and finalize MVP.
